backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Pristine Learning backend, providing album/image management, teacher profile CRUD (admin-gated), and Stripe payment integration via HTTP outcalls.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that the official contact email (pristinelearningofficial@gmail.com) is rendered as a mailto: link across the footer, dashboards, and homepage, with references to the relevant source files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing their purpose and key functionality for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the light and dark color themes used throughout the application.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the Pristine Learning React SPA, mounting the app into a root div and loading the main TypeScript entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes and wraps every page in a shared layout including the global Footer and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/BookingModal.tsx: Modal dialog for booking demo or paid sessions with a teacher, generating time slots, persisting bookings to local store, and sending in-app notifications to both student and teacher.
Shared dashboard shell component providing a responsive sidebar with role-specific navigation (admin/teacher/student), notification badge, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site-wide footer with brand info, navigation links for platform/teachers/students, contact email, and a copyright bar with a caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/MessageInbox.tsx: Displays a two-panel messaging inbox showing the user's conversations and messages, with polling for updates and a send-message mutation backed by a local store.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with logo, desktop/mobile nav links, and an authenticated user dropdown (dashboard, logout) or login button, using Internet Identity for auth.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog shown to new users to collect their name and role (student or teacher), saves the profile to local store, and redirects to the appropriate dashboard.
frontend/src/components/ReviewsSection.t: Displays a teacher's aggregated star ratings with a breakdown bar chart and a list of individual reviews, polling the reviews store every 10 seconds.
frontend/src/components/ReviewSubmission: Form component allowing a student to submit a star rating and optional text review for a completed booking, saving it to the reviews store and invalidating related queries.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetupModal: A dialog modal component for configuring Stripe payments, allowing admins to input a secret key and select allowed countries, then save the configuration via a mutation hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using TanStack Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider for React, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a custom hook backed by DFINITY's AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes TanStack Query hooks for all backend interactions including teacher profiles, user roles, Stripe configuration, checkout sessions, and related CRUD mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useTimezone.ts: A small hook that memoizes the user's local timezone and its abbreviation using the Intl API.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining the Tailwind CSS base, a teal-and-amber design token palette (light and dark modes via oklch), and reusable component utility classes like buttons, sidebar links, and card hover effects.
frontend/src/lib/localStore.ts: Provides TypeScript interfaces and localStorage-backed store helpers for client-side persistence of bookings, notifications, messages, reviews, wallet entries, and other data not stored in the backend.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with TanStack Query and Internet Identity providers wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page displaying platform analytics, bookings, withdrawals, referrals, subscription packages, and blog posts. Allows admins to approve/reject withdrawals and manage platform settings including Stripe configuration.
A study assistant page that uses rule-based generators to produce study materials, quizzes, and study plans for various subjects and curricula. Provides a tabbed UI with inputs for subject, curriculum, and topic selection.
frontend/src/pages/BlogListingPage.tsx: Displays a grid of published blog posts fetched from the local blog store, with cover images, author, date, and excerpt. Navigates to individual post pages on click.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPostPage.tsx: Renders a single blog post by slug with basic markdown-like content parsing for headings and lists. Shows a not-found state if the slug doesn't match any stored post.
frontend/src/pages/Homepage.tsx: Main landing page showcasing featured teachers, platform features, and a call-to-action for sign-up. Displays a profile setup modal for authenticated users without a profile.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Payment failure page that retrieves Stripe session status by session ID from the URL and displays an error message with options to retry or return home.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Displays a payment success confirmation page that verifies a Stripe session status via query param and shows loading, success, or failure states with navigation buttons to the student dashboard or search page.
frontend/src/pages/SessionRecordingsPage: Shows a student's completed session recordings fetched from the local bookings store, displaying available recordings as playable cards and listing sessions without recordings separately.
frontend/src/pages/StudentDashboard.tsx: Student dashboard page showing upcoming/completed bookings, subscription info, referral link, pending reviews, and a message inbox, with a profile setup modal for first-time users.
frontend/src/pages/SubscriptionPackagesP: Renders subscription plan cards (Basic, Standard, Premium) with pricing and features, handling Stripe checkout or local subscription activation when a user selects a plan.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherDashboard.tsx: Teacher dashboard displaying upcoming/completed bookings, wallet balance, demo slot creation form, referral link, and a message inbox, with a profile setup modal for new teachers.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherProfilePage.ts: Public teacher profile page showing bio, ratings, available demo slots, reviews, and booking/messaging actions, with loading skeletons and a booking modal for demo or paid sessions.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherSearchPage.tsx: A searchable, filterable teacher listing page that fetches teacher profiles and lets users filter by subject, language, grade, and price range, displaying results as cards with ratings, subjects, and a 'View Profile' navigation button.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherWalletPage.tsx: A teacher wallet dashboard page showing available balance, total earnings, pending withdrawals, and a transaction history table, with a dialog to submit withdrawal requests stored in local state.
frontend/src/utils/formatTime.ts: Utility module exporting functions to format timestamps into localized date-time strings, date-only strings, and timezone abbreviations using the Intl API.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for reading URL query parameters from both standard and hash-based routes, persisting them to sessionStorage, and clearing sensitive parameters from the URL without a page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins enabled.
project_state.json: Project state manifest describing the Pristine Learning tutoring marketplace, its tech stack (Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL), architectural notes, and a versioned list of implemented features including auth, booking, payments, and reviews.
